purpose: Prevent missing/unvisited records or placeholder zeroes from being interpreted as biological vacancy in the SMP hysteresis test.

required_confirmation_fields.confirmation_source: provider documentation, provider email/statement, or official SMP data dictionary
required_confirmation_fields.compatible_record_family_or_era: required non-empty description of the record family/era to which the zero semantics apply

runtime_rule: Stage B is unauthorized until all three semantic booleans are true, confirmation_source is non-empty, and a compatible start/end year plus record-family/era description are frozen. State extraction is restricted to that documented scope before Count values are converted to positive/zero state.
boundaries: If zero semantics differ among data eras or record families, restrict prospectively to the documented compatible era/family before occupancy states are inspected.
Do not infer zero semantics from the ecological pattern.
If the compatible zero-semantics interval is narrower than 1986-2024, Stage B uses only inherited complete years inside that interval; it may shorten but never extend a Stage-A panel.
After the provider-scope restriction, panels with <10 inherited complete years or <12-year span are dropped before vacancy spells are scanned.
